failure_policy: record every failure; abort split lock on any decode or feature failure; low-information pHash remains explicitly unaudited
holdout: media governance audit only before lock; never training, early stopping, threshold selection or hyperparameter tuning

near_duplicate_policy.embedding: cosine of L2-normalized mean ResNet18 frame features >=0.995, independent of duration
near_duplicate_policy.handling: union every threshold candidate as conservative leakage edge; does not establish duplicate truth, identity or source group
near_duplicate_policy.nearest_neighbors: top3 cosine neighbors recorded for every media; below both candidate thresholds retained as inspection diagnostics
near_duplicate_policy.phash: all 4 aligned frames valid, minimum bit agreement >=0.97, duration max/min <=1.03

purpose: local_research_only; exploratory Panda subset, no formal P1/P2
selection: full known-relation components; proportional fake-generator quotas; repeatedly choose largest relative generator deficit, then smallest SHA256(42:component) fitting remaining media budget
split: component greedy class+paired-generator stratification; seed42; cover each stratum in all splits first, then quadratic balance cost
